name: HCG (Human Chorionic Gonadotropin)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: HCG (Human Chorionic Gonadotropin) (CG) is a recombinant protein supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 4 pack sizes: 1000 iu, 2000 iu, 5000 iu, 10000 iu. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is HCG (Human Chorionic Gonadotropin) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: HCG (Human Chorionic Gonadotropin) is released lot by lot — HPLC for purity (≥99.0% (HPLC)) plus MS for mass — and the CG certificate lists the measured values alongside the identity entry (no public CAS entry).

faq.question: How should HCG (Human Chorionic Gonadotropin) be stored?
faq.answer: Dry powder for HCG (Human Chorionic Gonadotropin): store at −20 °C. Working solution: 2–8 °C, used within the window printed on the CG lot certificate.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for HCG (Human Chorionic Gonadotropin)?
faq.answer: HCG (Human Chorionic Gonadotropin) is stocked in 4 pack sizes (1000 IU, 2000 IU, 5000 IU, 10000 IU), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $35.66; 10–49 kits falls to $32.80 (−8%) and 50+ to $30.32 (−15%).

compliance: For Research, Laboratory, and Analytical Use Only. Not for Human or Veterinary Use.
